# 佛說寶雨經

**ID:** T0660
**Volume:** T16
**Category:** 經集部類
**Original Category:** 經集部
**Byline:** 唐 達摩流支譯
**Dynasty:** 唐
**Date:** 693
**Juans:** 10
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0660

## Contributors
- 菩提流志 (A001358)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

T660 (ten fascicles, alt. title 顯授不退轉菩薩記; Sanskrit *Ratnameghasūtra*) is the Tang retranslation of the same Indic *Ratnamegha* underlying [T658](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0296) (Mandrasena, 503) and [T659](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0297) (Mandrasena & Saṅghabhara, c. 503–524). The translator [達摩流支](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%81%94%E6%91%A9%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) (Dharmaruci, fl. late 7th c.) — to be distinguished from the early-sixth-century Northern Wei translator [Bodhiruci I](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) — was an Indian master active under Empress [武則天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9) Wǔ Zétiān. T660 is the most expanded and politically significant Chinese version of the *Ratnamegha*: its colophon explicitly invokes the legitimacy of Wǔ Zétiān's reign through a passage predicting that a female cakravartin will appear in the East to spread the Dharma, a passage absent from [T658](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0296) and [T659](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0297) and probably interpolated to support her imperial claims.

**Abstract**

The Tang catalogs (*[Kāiyuán shìjiào lù](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093)* T2154; *Zhēnyuán xīndìng shìjiào mùlù* T2157) date T660 precisely to Chángshòu 長壽 2 = 693 CE, completed at the Fóshòujì sì 佛授記寺 in Luòyáng under direct imperial patronage. Date bracket: 693 (single year). The text was a key tool in the propaganda programme that established [武則天](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%AD%A6%E5%89%87%E5%A4%A9) Wǔ Zétiān as Maitreya-elect / cakravartin-queen; Antonino Forte's classic study (1976) demonstrates that the prophecy of the female cakravartin was inserted by the translation team — possibly with [薛懷義](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%96%9B%E6%87%B7%E7%BE%A9) and [法明](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B3%95%E6%98%8E) — to provide scriptural warrant for her assumption of the throne. Modern scholarship (Forte 1976, 2005) treats T660 as Exhibit A in the Wǔ Zétiān propaganda corpus.

In the Kanripo catalog meta the translator is recorded as 達摩流支 (Dharmaruci), distinct from the Northern Wei [Bodhiruci I](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%8F%A9%E6%8F%90%E6%B5%81%E6%94%AF) (fl. 508–537); the *[Kāiyuán](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0093)* catalog explicitly distinguishes them.
